firstMove.text: I would tell her it gets better
firstMove.question: Meera says she can't cope. What do you say first?
firstMove.invitation: This is how you answered at the very start. How would you answer it now?

possibleSelf.invitation: You said this is the helper you want to become. Does it still fit?

doors.title: Try it on your next shift
doors.body: On your next shift, watch for this: the moment a caller goes quiet. Afterwards, come back and tell me what happened.

doors.title: A short look back in a week
doors.body: Three quick questions, seven days from now, to help what you learned stick.

doors.title: Leave a line for the next learner
doors.body: What would you tell someone just starting this course?
